title: feat(scenarios): the scenario scorer moves into @objectstack/scenarios and judges capability tags, agent-action exposure, write outcomes and per-persona answers
body:
Fixes #30291
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：确定性场景评分器整体从 `packages/cli` 迁入私有包 `@objectstack/scenarios`（裁决 D）。新增封闭的能力标签检查表、Agent 动作暴露检查、写操作结果判分和按角色判分，并提供给运行器用的入口 `@objectstack/scenarios/score`。
- 为什么改：维护者裁定方案 D（「同意 D」），评分器和卡片格式放在一起。已发布的 CLI 不再携带任何场景代码，也不再需要依赖私有包。
- 风险与回滚：CLI 只把 `MetadataEvalCase` 类型挪到 `corpus.ts` 并原名重导出，行为不变。评分器此前没有从 CLI 发布过。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-tags.ts`（标签表与动作暴露判定）、`packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/index.ts`（运行器入口）、`.changeset/30290-scenario-scorer-port.md` 的删除（见下方"需要你做的"）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test`，预期 11 个文件、163 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的：确认删除尚未发布的 `.changeset/30290-scenario-scorer-port.md`。它写的是"CLI 新增评分器"，迁移后这句话已不成立。`check-empty-changeset` 对这类有意更正会一直保持红色，直到有人确认。

## What changes

Per the maintainer's ruling D on #30291 (「同意 D」), the deterministic scenario scorer lives in the private `@objectstack/scenarios` package (`packages/qa/scenarios`), beside the card format it judges. No model call anywhere (cost ruling on objectstack-ai/cloud#3600: 「目前阶段尽量不要用云端的token，api的更贵」).

- **Moved with `git mv`, so history follows:** `scenario-score`, `scenario-graph` and `scenario-run-grade` (merged in #30332), `scenario-tags` and `scenario-operation-grade`, and their tests. They go from `packages/cli/src/lint/` to `packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/` and `test/score/`. `@objectstack/cli` ends with no scenario code and no mirrored card types.
- **The graders take the card schema's own types:** `ScenarioExpect`, `z.infer` of `OutcomeSchema` and `PostStateSchema`, a `Pick` of `ScenarioCard`, and the loader's `Truth`. The `expect`, outcome, persona, agent-action and truth mirrors are gone.
- **`@objectstack/scenarios/score`** (private subpath) is the runner's entry (#30292). It has three functions, and each takes a card the loader returned:
  - `scoreCardArtifact(card, artifact)`;
  - `gradeCardOperation(card, operationId, observation)`;
  - `gradeCardAnswer(card, { question, persona?, turn })`. The persona's hidden objects and fields are read off the card.
- **Capability-tag checks** (`scenario-tags.ts`): a closed table of nine rows, listed in the package README for the mid-tier card authors.
  - A tag with no row is `unscored`, never a pass. So is a row whose card gives it nothing to judge. Both are counted nowhere.
  - A row that runs zero checks fails.
  - Rows read the owning predicates (`resolveFlowTriggerKind`, `APPROVAL_NODE_TYPE`, `SINGLE_OPTION_TYPES`, `summaryFunctionReadsField`, `effectiveSharingModel`, `standaloneActionOwnerKey`). Collections are read through `resolveStackCollection` from its owner, `@objectstack/core`.
- **Agent-action exposure:** each declared action must exist on its object, carry `ai.exposed: true` (the MCP doors' opt-in) and, where the card says `confirm`, carry `ai.requiresConfirmation: true` (the flag the confirmation gate enforces, not the delete-mode listing heuristic). A missing action fails all of its checks.
- **Write-operation grader:**
  - applied: every post-state is read back, one row per `where`, and the audit actor matches;
  - refused: the exact `ErrorCode`, with zero writes;
  - pending_confirmation: zero writes.

  An unobserved fact fails.
- **Per-persona Run grading:**
  - a `withheld` truth is must-not-reveal: a decline is correct, and a stated all-rows figure is a leak;
  - an all-rows figure outside a scoped persona's rows is a leak when the reply states it.
- **Dependencies** of the private package: `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/plugin-sharing` (workspace). Its vitest config aliases each to source (`check:test-source-alias`).
- **Gates re-homed:**
  - the cross-package inputs move from `@objectstack/cli#test` to the scenarios entry and task, which also declare `packages/cli/src/lint/corpus.ts` (the golden builds and the drift pin read it);
  - the `second-object-read-exposure` pin row for `scenario-graph.ts` follows the file (same `not-a-served-read` class).
- **CLI:** `MetadataEvalCase` is declared in `corpus.ts`, beside the corpus it types, and `metadata-eval.ts` re-exports it under the same name. That keeps the scenarios type-check program from pulling in the whole lint command.
- **Changesets:** one changeset (`@objectstack/scenarios` and `@objectstack/cli`, patch). The unreleased `.changeset/30290-scenario-scorer-port.md` is **deleted on purpose**: it announces a scorer in the CLI that this PR moves out, so it is a deliberate correction of a pending release note. `check-empty-changeset` stays red on it until a person confirms.
- Body item 2 (`os lint --eval` reads cards) is cancelled by the ruling.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test`: 11 files, 163 tests. Moved suites unchanged in what they assert. Added `test/score/entry.test.ts` (the runner entry over the real `crm_account_with_contacts` card).
- `scenario-cards.test.ts` loads the control cards through the loader:
  - **corpus drift pin.** Each control card's `expect` must equal what `corpus.ts` derives, with a floor of exactly 3 controls;
  - **end-to-end readings:** crm 10/18, invoice 18/27, project 19/26;
  - crm completed with what it asks scores 1, and each removal scores lower.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core exec vitest run src/security/second-object-read-exposure.pin.test.ts`: 4/4.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`, build, and `vitest run test/metadata-eval.test.ts src/lint/`: 43/43.

## Acceptance notes

- **Tag names.** `travel_expense.json` (merged meanwhile) declares 12 tags. Five score: `master-detail-inline-edit`, `roll-up-summary`, `select-options`, `automation.record-triggered-flow` and `access-security.field-permissions`. The rest are `unscored`: `records-forms.formula-field`, `records-forms.validation-rule`, `approvals.multi-step-approval`, `access-security.row-level-security`, `dashboards.report`, `ai.ask-data` and `ai.agent-actions`. The README table is what the remaining five card authors align to, or extend.
- **Size.** `dispatch-gates` reads 4324 changed lines: it counts with `--no-renames`, so every moved file counts twice. The rename-aware count is 1806, and that is how GitHub counts. Two controls: #30375 is 6567 no-renames vs 1561 rename-aware vs GitHub 1561; #30550 is 3228 vs 2482 vs GitHub 2482.
- The round-2 gate-forced additions to `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` and `turbo.json` are recorded as accepted on #30291. They now point at the scenarios package.

## Verification

### One ablation per moved module, at the new home (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; tests import src relatively, so no dist leg)

Every mutation landed (anchor 1 → 0) and was restored (blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):

| module | mutation | result |
|:---|:---|:---|
| scenario-score | widget measure check → pass | 2 failed / 16 |
| scenario-graph | nav entry resolves → true | 2 failed / 5 |
| scenario-run-grade | withheld leak scan off | 1 failed / 19 |
| scenario-tags | master-detail inlineEdit → true | 1 failed / 30 |
| scenario-operation-grade | no-write → true | 2 failed / 13 |
| score/index | operation judged against the wrong outcome | 1 failed / 7 |

The full per-check battery of the previous round (18 mutations) ran against the same assertions before the move.


### Gates

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` on the patch-round diff: 91 commands, all run, exit codes captured before any pipe.
- `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main`: exit 1, the deliberate-correction refusal on `30290-scenario-scorer-port.md` (above).
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage`: exit 3 `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`. They read every package's built output; NOT MEASURED, CI owns them.
- Every other family: exit 0, including `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:ci-filter-parity`, `check:turbo-task-graph`, `check:undeclared-dep-imports`, `check:test-source-alias` and `check:workspace-manifest-cycles`.
- Clause-② closure: walking the relative imports of the CLI's `dist/index.d.ts`, `dist/console.d.ts` and `dist/hook-body.d.ts` reaches 39 files, none a scenario file, and no bare `@objectstack/scenarios` specifier. `dist/lint/` holds only `corpus`, `hook-body-lowering`, `metadata-eval` and `score`.
- Dogfood: n/a. No `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.
